segments.title: The order requests, hooks, form, layout and routes
context: This segment adds the code the three order pages share: the order requests, the query hooks around them, the order form and the order types. It also adds the order routes and an "Orders" link to the header of every page.
:::accordion
::section What's added
- [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders): added a new function that sends a `GET` request to [`/api/orders`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L5) and returns every order.
- [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder): added a new function that sends a `GET` request to [`/api/orders/<orderId>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9) and returns that order.

- [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder): added a new function that sends a [`POST`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L13) request to [`/api/orders`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L13) with [`draft`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L13) as its JSON body.

- [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder): added a new function that sends a [`PUT`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L17) request to [`/api/orders/<order.id>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L17) with every field of [`order`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L17) as its JSON body.

- [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders): added a new hook that queries every order with [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L7) under the query key [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L7).

- [`useOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrder): added a new hook that queries one order with [`fetchOrder(orderId)`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L11) under the query key [`[...ORDERS_QUERY_KEY, orderId]`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L11).

- [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useCreateOrder): added a new hook that returns a mutation calling [`createOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L17) and, on success, [`invalidateQueries()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L18) on [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L18).

- [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder): added a new hook that returns a mutation calling [`updateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L25) and, on success, [`invalidateQueries()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L26) on [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L26).
- [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#OrderForm): added a new component that renders the order form the create and edit pages share.

- Takes [`initialDraft`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L14), [`submitLabel`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L14), [`isSaving`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L14) and [`onSubmit`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L14) as props, and keeps the draft in state with [`useState(initialDraft)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L15).

- Renders a [`<select>`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L26-36) of the customers from [`useCustomers()`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L16), a [`<select>`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L37-47) of the products from [`useProducts()`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L17) and a number [`<Input>`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L48-54) for the quantity with [`min={1}`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L51).
- Disables its submit [`<Button>`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L55) while [`isSaving`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L55) is true.
- Calls [`onSubmit(draft)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L21) on submit.

- [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order): added a new interface with [`id`](code:src/types/order.ts#L4), [`customerId`](code:src/types/order.ts#L5), [`productId`](code:src/types/order.ts#L6), [`quantity`](code:src/types/order.ts#L7) and [`status`](code:src/types/order.ts#L8), along with [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#L1), which is [`"pending" | "shipped"`](code:src/types/order.ts#L1), and [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#L11), which is [`Omit<Order, "id">`](code:src/types/order.ts#L11).
::section What's modified
- [`router`](code:src/router.tsx#router): modified the route config to add three routes under `/`.
- [`orders`](code:src/router.tsx#L17) renders [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/router.tsx#L17).
- [`orders/new`](code:src/router.tsx#L18) renders [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/router.tsx#L18).
- [`orders/:orderId/edit`](code:src/router.tsx#L19) renders [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/router.tsx#L19).

- [`<RootLayout />`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#RootLayout): modified the component to render an "Orders" [`<Link>`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L12) to [`/orders`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L12) between the ["Products"](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L11) and ["Help"](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L13) links.

waypoints.title: Added the imports of `request` and the order types
waypoints.reading: The author added two imports that name [`request()`](code:src/api/client.ts#L13-20) from `@/api/client` and the types [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order) and [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft) from `@/types/order`. The four functions of this file call `request()`, which [puts `/api` before each path](code:src/api/client.ts#L14) and [throws an `ApiError` when the response is not ok](code:src/api/client.ts#L18).

waypoints.title: Added `fetchOrders()` to request every order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `fetchOrders()` that sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders` and returns the parsed body as an `Order[]`. [`useOrders()` hands it to `useQuery` as its query function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L7), so that [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage) lists the orders the server returns.

waypoints.title: Added `fetchOrder()` to request one order by its id
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `fetchOrder()` that sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders/<orderId>` and returns the parsed body as an `Order`. [`useOrder()` calls it in its query function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L11), so that [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#EditOrderPage) fills the form with the order of the URL.

waypoints.title: Added `createOrder()` to send a new order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `createOrder()` that sends a `POST` request to `/api/orders` with the draft as its JSON body, and returns the order the server answers with. [`useCreateOrder()` uses it as its mutation function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L17), so that a submit of [the create order page](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L12-14) sends the draft to the server. [`request()` sets the `Content-Type` header to `application/json`](code:src/api/client.ts#L16).

waypoints.title: Added `updateOrder()` to send an edited order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `updateOrder()` that sends a `PUT` request to `/api/orders/<order.id>` with the whole order as its JSON body, `id` included, and returns the order the server answers with. [`useUpdateOrder()` uses it as its mutation function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L25). [`<EditOrderPage />` builds the order from the draft and the `orderId` of the URL](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L15), so that the path and the body name the same order.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the one request that changes an order the server already has. The `PUT` sends every field of the order to `/api/orders/<id>`, so `status`, which no field of [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#OrderForm) shows, is sent back as it was loaded.

waypoints.title: Added the imports of the query hooks and the order requests
waypoints.reading: The author added two imports that name `useMutation`, `useQuery` and `useQueryClient` from `@tanstack/react-query`, and [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder), [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder), [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders) and [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder) from `@/api/orders`. [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders) and the three hooks after it hand each request to a query or a mutation.

waypoints.title: Added the query key `ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `ORDERS_QUERY_KEY` that is `["orders"]`. [`useOrders()` uses it as its key](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L7), and [`useOrder()` puts the order id after it](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L11). [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L18) and [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L26) invalidate every query whose key starts with it, so that after a save the list and every cached order are requested again the next time a page reads them.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrders()` to query every order
waypoints.reading: The author added a hook `useOrders()` that calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders"]` and [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders) as its query function. [`<ViewOrdersPage />` calls it](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L5), so that the list page renders the orders the `GET` request returns. `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `staleTime` to 30 000 ms, so the list reuses a result younger than 30 seconds unless a save invalidated it.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrder()` to query one order by its id
waypoints.reading: The author added a hook `useOrder()` that calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders", orderId]` and a query function that calls [`fetchOrder(orderId)`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder). [`<EditOrderPage />` calls it with the `orderId` of the URL](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L9), so that the edit form starts from the order the server returns. The id is part of the key, so each order has a cache entry of its own under `["orders"]`.

waypoints.title: Added `useCreateOrder()` to create an order and refresh the orders
waypoints.reading:
The author added a hook `useCreateOrder()` that returns a mutation that:

- calls [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder) with the draft it is given
- invalidates every query whose key starts with [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#ORDERS_QUERY_KEY) when the request succeeds

[`<CreateOrderPage />` calls it](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L10), so that the list shows the new order when the page opens `/orders` after the save.

children.title: Added the read of the query client
children.reading: The author added a statement that reads the `QueryClient` of the app with `useQueryClient()`. That is the `queryClient` that `src/main.tsx` passes to `QueryClientProvider`. [The `onSuccess` callback of the mutation calls `invalidateQueries()` on it](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L18).

children.title: Added the mutation that creates an order
children.reading: The author added a call to `useMutation` with `createOrder` as its mutation function and an `onSuccess` callback that calls `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ORDERS_QUERY_KEY })`. [`<CreateOrderPage />` reads `mutate` of the result as `saveOrder`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L10), so that a submit of the create form sends the `POST` request.

waypoints.title: Added `useUpdateOrder()` to update an order and refresh the orders
waypoints.reading:
The author added a hook `useUpdateOrder()` that returns a mutation that:

- calls [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder) with the order it is given
- invalidates every query whose key starts with [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#ORDERS_QUERY_KEY) when the request succeeds

[`<EditOrderPage />` calls it](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L10), so that the list and the cached order show the edit when the page opens `/orders` after the save.

children.title: Added the read of the query client
children.reading: The author added a statement that reads the `QueryClient` of the app with `useQueryClient()`. That is the `queryClient` that `src/main.tsx` passes to `QueryClientProvider`. [The `onSuccess` callback of the mutation calls `invalidateQueries()` on it](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L26).

children.title: Added the mutation that updates an order
children.reading: The author added a call to `useMutation` with `updateOrder` as its mutation function and an `onSuccess` callback that calls `queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ORDERS_QUERY_KEY })`. [`<EditOrderPage />` reads `mutate` of the result as `saveOrder`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L10), so that a submit of the edit form sends the `PUT` request.

waypoints.title: Added the imports of the three order pages
waypoints.reading: The author added three imports that name [`ViewOrdersPage`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage) from `@/routes/orders`, [`CreateOrderPage`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#CreateOrderPage) from `@/routes/orders/create` and [`EditOrderPage`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#EditOrderPage) from `@/routes/orders/edit`. [`router` renders each of them at a route](code:src/router.tsx#L17-19).

waypoints.title: Modified `router` to add the three order routes
waypoints.reading:
The author added three routes to `router`, under the `/` route:

- `orders`, which renders [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage)
- `orders/new`, which renders [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#CreateOrderPage)
- `orders/:orderId/edit`, which renders [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#EditOrderPage)

The three pages render in [the `<Outlet />` of `<RootLayout />`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L20), so that the header stays above each order page. [`<EditOrderPage />` reads `orderId` from the URL](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L7).

waypoints.title: Added the imports of the form's state, controls and lists
waypoints.reading: The author added five imports that name `useState` and the type `FormEvent` from `react`, [`Button`](code:src/components/ui/button.tsx#L14-16) and [`Input`](code:src/components/ui/input.tsx#L3-5) from `@/components/ui`, [`useCustomers()`](code:src/hooks/use-customers.ts#L6-8), [`useProducts()`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L6-8) and the type [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft). The two list hooks are the hooks the customers page and the products page call, so that the form reads the cache entries `["customers"]` and `["products"]` of those pages.

waypoints.title: Added the props of `<OrderForm />`
waypoints.reading: The author added an interface `OrderFormProps` with `initialDraft`, an [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft), `submitLabel`, `isSaving` and `onSubmit`, a function that takes an `OrderDraft`. [`<CreateOrderPage />` passes `EMPTY_DRAFT`, `"Create"`, the pending state of its mutation and its `handleSubmit()`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L19). [`<EditOrderPage />` passes the loaded order, `"Save"`, its own pending state and its own `handleSubmit()`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L21). So both pages render one form, and each page decides which request a submit sends.

waypoints.title: Added `<OrderForm />` to edit a draft and submit it
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<OrderForm />` that:

- keeps the draft in state, starting from `initialDraft`
- renders a select of the customers of [`useCustomers()`](code:src/hooks/use-customers.ts#L6-8) and a select of the products of [`useProducts()`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L6-8)
- renders a number input for the quantity, with a minimum of 1
- writes each change of a field into a copy of the draft
- calls `onSubmit(draft)` when the form is submitted, and disables the submit button while `isSaving` is `true`

[`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L19) and [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L21) both render it, so that the create page and the edit page show the same three fields.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the form both new pages exist to show: it decides which fields an order has and what a submit hands to [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L12-14) and [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L14-16).

children.title: Added the draft state of the form
children.reading: The author added a state `draft` that starts as `initialDraft`. `useState` reads `initialDraft` on the first render only, so [`<EditOrderPage />` returns a message until the order is loaded](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L11-12), and the form starts from that order.

children.title: Added the list of customers for the customer select
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useCustomers()`](code:src/hooks/use-customers.ts#L6-8) that reads `data` as `customers`, with `[]` while the customers load. [The customer select renders one option per customer](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L31-35).

children.title: Added the list of products for the product select
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useProducts()`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L6-8) that reads `data` as `products`, with `[]` while the products load. [The product select renders one option per product](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L42-46).

children.title: Added the submit handler of the form
children.reading: The author added a function `handleSubmit()` that calls `event.preventDefault()` and then `onSubmit(draft)`. [The `<form>` calls it on submit](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L25), so that the page that renders the form receives the draft and the browser does not reload.

children.title: Added the submit event of the form
children.reading: The author added an `onSubmit` attribute that passes [`handleSubmit()`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L19-22) to the `<form>`. [The submit button](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L55-57) and Enter in a field both submit the form, so that both run the same handler.

children.title: Added the change handler of the customer select
children.reading: The author added an `onChange` handler that sets `draft` to a copy with `customerId` set to the value of the chosen option. [The select reads its value from `draft.customerId`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L28), so that the select shows the customer the draft holds.

children.title: Added one option per customer
children.reading: The author added a loop that renders one `<option>` per customer, with `customer.id` as its value and `customer.name` as its text. [The customer select](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L26-30) shows these options, so that a staff member picks a customer by name and the draft holds its id.

children.title: Added the change handler of the product select
children.reading: The author added an `onChange` handler that sets `draft` to a copy with `productId` set to the value of the chosen option. [The select reads its value from `draft.productId`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L39), so that the select shows the product the draft holds.

children.title: Added one option per product
children.reading: The author added a loop that renders one `<option>` per product, with `product.id` as its value and `product.name` as its text. [The product select](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L37-41) shows these options, so that a staff member picks a product by name and the draft holds its id.

children.title: Added the change handler of the quantity input
children.reading: The author added an `onChange` handler that sets `draft` to a copy with `quantity` set to `Number(event.target.value)`. [The input reads its value from `draft.quantity`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L52), so that the draft holds a number and not the text of the input.

waypoints.title: Modified `<RootLayout />` to link to the orders
waypoints.reading: The author added a `<Link>` to `/orders` with the text "Orders", between the "Products" and "Help" links. [`router` renders `<RootLayout />` at the `/` route](code:src/router.tsx#L11-13), around every page, so that every page links to [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage).

waypoints.title: Added the type `OrderStatus`
waypoints.reading: The author added a type `OrderStatus` that is `"pending"` or `"shipped"`. It is the type of [`Order.status`](code:src/types/order.ts#L8), and [`EMPTY_DRAFT` sets it to `"pending"`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L6), so that a new order starts as pending. No field of [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#OrderForm) changes the status.

waypoints.title: Added the interface `Order`
waypoints.reading: The author added an interface `Order` with `id`, `customerId` and `productId` as strings, `quantity` as a number and `status` as an [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus). [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4) and [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L8) return it, and [`updateOrder()` takes it](code:src/api/orders.ts#L16), so that the `PUT` request carries the id with the fields. [`request()` casts the JSON body to the type](code:src/api/client.ts#L19) and does not validate it.

waypoints.title: Added the type `OrderDraft` for an order with no id
waypoints.reading: The author added a type `OrderDraft` that is [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order) without `id`. [`<OrderForm />` edits one](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L8) and [`createOrder()` sends one](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12-13), so that a new order has no id until the server returns it.

segments.title: The create order page
context: This segment adds the page that creates an order. It starts the form with a quantity of one, and after a save it goes back to the orders list.
:::accordion
::section What's added
- [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#CreateOrderPage): added a new page component that creates an order.

- Renders [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L19) with [`EMPTY_DRAFT`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L19) as its initial draft, which sets [`quantity: 1`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L6) and [`status: "pending"`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L6).

waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `EMPTY_DRAFT` that sets `customerId` and `productId` to `""`, `quantity` to `1` and `status` to `"pending"`. waypoints.title: Added `<CreateOrderPage />` to create an order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<CreateOrderPage />` that:

- renders [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#OrderForm) with [`EMPTY_DRAFT`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#EMPTY_DRAFT), the label "Create" and the pending state of the mutation
- calls the mutation of [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useCreateOrder) with the draft the form submits
- opens `/orders` when the `POST` request succeeds

[`router` renders it at `orders/new`](code:src/router.tsx#L18), so that [the "Create order" link of `<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L11) opens a form that creates an order.

children.title: Added the navigate function of the create page
children.reading: The author added a call to `useNavigate()` that returns the function that changes the URL. [The `onSuccess` callback of `handleSubmit()` calls it with `/orders`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L13).

children.title: Added the create mutation of the page
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useCreateOrder) that reads its `mutate` as `saveOrder` and its `isPending`. [`handleSubmit()` calls `saveOrder`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L13), and [`<OrderForm />` receives `isPending` as `isSaving`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L19), so that the submit button is disabled while the `POST` request runs.

children.title: Added the submit handler of the create page
children.reading: The author added a function `handleSubmit()` that calls `saveOrder(draft)` with an `onSuccess` callback that calls `navigate("/orders")`. [`<OrderForm />` receives it as `onSubmit`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L19), so that a submit of the form sends the `POST` request and the list opens when it succeeds.

children.title: Added the draft argument of the create handler
children.reading: The author added an argument `draft`, an [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft). [`<OrderForm />` calls `onSubmit(draft)` with its state](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L21), so that the handler receives the fields as the staff member left them.

children.title: Added the call that saves the new order
children.reading: The author added a call to `saveOrder(draft, { onSuccess })` whose `onSuccess` calls `navigate("/orders")`. [The mutation of `useCreateOrder()` sends the `POST` request and invalidates the orders](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L16-19), so that [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage) requests the orders again when it opens. A failed request calls no `onSuccess`, and the page stays on the form.

children.title: Added the form of the create page
children.reading: The author added `<OrderForm />` with [`EMPTY_DRAFT`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#EMPTY_DRAFT) as `initialDraft`, `"Create"` as `submitLabel`, `isPending` as `isSaving` and [`handleSubmit()`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L12-14) as `onSubmit`. [`<OrderForm />` calls `onSubmit` when the form is submitted](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L19-22), so that a submit reaches the handler of this page.

segments.title: The edit order page
context: This segment adds the page that edits an existing order. It loads the order named in the address, fills the form with it, and after a save goes back to the orders list.
:::accordion
::section What's added
- [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#EditOrderPage): added a new page component that edits an existing order.
- Reads [`orderId`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L7) from [`useParams()`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L7) and loads the order with [`useOrder(orderId)`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L9).
- Shows ["Loading the order…"](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L11) while it loads and ["The order could not be loaded."](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L12) if it fails.
- Renders [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L21) with the loaded [`order`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L21) as its initial draft.

- Calls [`saveOrder({ ...draft, id: orderId })`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L15) from [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L10) on submit, and [`navigate("/orders")`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L15) on success.

waypoints.title: Added the imports of the edit order page
waypoints.reading: The author added four imports that name `useNavigate` and `useParams` from `react-router`, [`useOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrder) and [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder), the type [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft) and [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#OrderForm). [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#EditOrderPage) uses all of them.

waypoints.title: Added `<EditOrderPage />` to load an order and save it
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<EditOrderPage />` that:

- reads `orderId` from the URL, with `""` when the URL has none
- loads the order with [`useOrder(orderId)`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrder), and returns a loading message or an error message until the order is there
- renders [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#OrderForm) with the loaded order, the label "Save" and the pending state of the mutation
- calls the mutation of [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder) with the draft and `id: orderId`, and opens `/orders` when the `PUT` request succeeds

[`router` renders it at `orders/:orderId/edit`](code:src/router.tsx#L19), so that [the "Edit" link of each row of `<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L20) opens the form of that order.
waypoints.needsAttention: This page decides which order a save writes: [it sets `id` to the `orderId` of the URL](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L15), and the form starts from the order the `GET` request returned.

children.title: Added the order id read from the URL
children.reading: The author added a call to `useParams()` that reads `orderId`, with `""` when the URL has none. [The `orders/:orderId/edit` route](code:src/router.tsx#L19) names the parameter, so `orderId` is the id of the row whose "Edit" link a staff member clicked.

children.title: Added the navigate function of the edit page
children.reading: The author added a call to `useNavigate()` that returns the function that changes the URL. [The `onSuccess` callback of `handleSubmit()` calls it with `/orders`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L15).

children.title: Added the query of the order to edit
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useOrder(orderId)`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrder) that reads `data` as `order`, and `isPending` and `isError`. [The two conditions below return a message while `isPending` or `isError` is `true`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L11-12), so that [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L21) renders only with a loaded order.

children.title: Added the update mutation of the page
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder) that reads its `mutate` as `saveOrder` and its `isPending` as `isSaving`. The query of the order already uses the name `isPending`. [`<OrderForm />` receives `isSaving`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L21), so that the submit button is disabled while the `PUT` request runs.

children.title: Added the loading message of the edit page
children.reading:
The author added a condition that returns `

Loading the order…

` while `isPending` is `true`. [`useState` in `` reads `initialDraft` on the first render only](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L15), so that this condition makes the form start from the loaded order and not from `undefined`.

children.title: Added the error message of the edit page
children.reading:
The author added a condition that returns `

The order could not be loaded.

` when `isError` is `true`. [`request()` throws an `ApiError` for a response that is not ok](code:src/api/client.ts#L18), and `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `retry` to `false`, so one failed `GET` request to `/api/orders/` shows this message, a 404 for an unknown id included.

children.title: Added the submit handler of the edit page
children.reading: The author added a function `handleSubmit()` that calls `saveOrder()` with the draft and `id: orderId`, and an `onSuccess` callback that calls `navigate("/orders")`. [`<OrderForm />` receives it as `onSubmit`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L21), so that a submit of the form sends the `PUT` request and the list opens when it succeeds.

children.title: Added the draft argument of the edit handler
children.reading: The author added an argument `draft`, an [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft). [`<OrderForm />` calls `onSubmit(draft)` with its state](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L21), so that the handler receives the fields as the staff member left them.

children.title: Added the call that saves the edited order
children.reading: The author added a call to `saveOrder()` with a copy of the draft whose `id` is `orderId`, and an `onSuccess` callback that calls `navigate("/orders")`. [The mutation of `useUpdateOrder()` sends the `PUT` request and invalidates the orders](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L24-27), so that [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage) requests the orders again when it opens.

children.title: Added the id of the URL to the saved order
children.reading: The author added `id: orderId` after the spread of the draft. The draft starts from the loaded order, so it holds an `id` already. This property sets `id` to [the `orderId` of the URL](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L7), so that [`updateOrder()` sends the `PUT` request to the path of that id](code:src/api/orders.ts#L17).

children.title: Added the return to the list after a save
children.reading: The author added an `onSuccess` callback that calls `navigate("/orders")`. `saveOrder()` calls it when the `PUT` request succeeds, so that [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage) opens and requests the orders again. A failed request calls no `onSuccess`, and the page stays on the form.

children.title: Added the form of the edit page
children.reading: The author added `<OrderForm />` with `order` as `initialDraft`, `"Save"` as `submitLabel`, `isSaving` and [`handleSubmit()`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L14-16) as `onSubmit`. `order` is an [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order), so the draft keeps the `id` and the `status` of the loaded order. [`<OrderForm />` calls `onSubmit` when the form is submitted](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderForm.tsx#L19-22).

segments.title: The orders list page
context: This segment adds the page that lists every order, with a link to create one and a link to edit each.
:::accordion
::section What's added
- [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage): added a new page component that lists every order.
- Loads the orders with [`useOrders()`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L5).

- Shows ["Loading the orders…"](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L6) while [`isPending`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L6) and ["The orders could not be loaded."](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7) when [`isError`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7).
- Renders a "Create order" [`<Link>`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L11) to [`/orders/new`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L11).

- Renders a [`<tr>`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L15-22) per order with [`order.id`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L16), [`order.quantity`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L17), [`order.status`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L18) and an "Edit" [`<Link>`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L20) to [`/orders/${order.id}/edit`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L20).

journeyNodes.label: Renders the three order pages at their paths
journeyNodes.description: When the app starts, `src/main.tsx` passes this route table to `<RouterProvider />`. When a staff member opens `/orders`, `/orders/new` or `/orders/<id>/edit`, `<RouterProvider />` renders the element of the matching route inside [`<RootLayout />`](code:src/router.tsx#L13).

blockLabels.label: Renders the list of orders at /orders

journeyNodes.label: Lists every order with a link to edit it
journeyNodes.description: When a staff member clicks "Orders" in the header or opens `/orders`, [the `orders` route of `router`](code:src/router.tsx#L17) renders this page.

blockLabels.label: The orders loaded from the server
Shows a loading message until the orders arrive
Shows an error message when the request fails
Renders one row per order

journeyNodes.label: Queries every order
journeyNodes.description: When a staff member opens `/orders`, [`router` renders `<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/router.tsx#L17), and [`<ViewOrdersPage />` calls this hook](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L5).

blockLabels.label: Names the cache entry of every order query
Loads the orders under the key ["orders"]
Requests every order from the server

journeyNodes.label: Sends `GET /api/orders`
journeyNodes.description: When a staff member opens `/orders`, [`<ViewOrdersPage />` calls `useOrders()`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L5), and [`useOrders()` hands this function to `useQuery` as its query function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L7).

waypoints.title: Added the imports of the orders page
waypoints.reading: The author added two imports that name `Link` from `react-router` and [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders) from `@/hooks/use-orders`. [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#ViewOrdersPage) uses both.

waypoints.title: Added `<ViewOrdersPage />` to list every order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<ViewOrdersPage />` that:

- loads the orders with [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders)
- returns a loading message or an error message until the orders are there
- renders a "Create order" link to `/orders/new`
- renders one row per order with its id, its quantity, its status and an "Edit" link to `/orders/<id>/edit`

[`router` renders it at `orders`](code:src/router.tsx#L17), and [the "Orders" link of the header](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L12) opens it. [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/create.tsx#L13) and [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#L15) open `/orders` after a save.

children.title: Added the query of every order
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders) that reads `data` as `orders`, and `isPending` and `isError`. [The two conditions below return a message for the last two](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L6-7), so that [the loop of rows](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L14-23) runs on a loaded list only.

children.title: Added the loading message of the orders page
children.reading:
The author added a condition that returns `

Loading the orders…

` while `isPending` is `true`. When the list is in the cache already, as it is when [a save invalidates the orders](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L18), `isPending` is `false`, and the page shows the cached list while the new request runs.

children.title: Added the error message of the orders page
children.reading:
The author added a condition that returns `

The orders could not be loaded.

` when `isError` is `true`. [`request()` throws an `ApiError` when the response is not ok](code:src/api/client.ts#L18), and `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `retry` to `false`, so one failed `GET` request to `/api/orders` shows this message.

children.title: Added one row per order
children.reading: The author added a loop that renders one `<tr>` per order, with `order.id`, `order.quantity`, `order.status` and a link to `/orders/<order.id>/edit`. [The `orders/:orderId/edit` route](code:src/router.tsx#L19) renders [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/edit.tsx#EditOrderPage) for that link, so that each row opens the edit form of its order. The row does not show the customer or the product.
